column1: # What each check costs on CI, measured from CI's own logs (#262).
# `seconds` is the whole check -- summed over its shards where it has them --
# as the median over the runs listed, written by
# `scripts/measure-check-seconds.py RUN_ID ...`, never by a local run.
# scripts/check-ci-coverage.py reads THIS table, never a live run, so its
# verdict is the same on every run: a package whose checks' seconds, each
# divided by its shard count, sum past `wall_clock_seconds` is refused, and
# so is a check with no row. A pull request that changes a check's cost
# re-measures its row; verify.sh prints each check's actual seconds against
# its row, so drift is visible before the refusal fires.
